name: Linda
primary_objection: We need to get other estimates.
trust_unlock: Ask which privacy or security problem prompted the visit and what must happen before she is ready.
spouse_status: Sole decision-maker; consults an adult family member but does not require their approval.
same_day_close_condition: Clarify real timing, compare standard and modern options using LF/unit pricing and 3-year material/labor warranty, ask for the business respectfully.
competitor_quote: Budget estimate for standard open bars, basic latch and no keyed lock; not equivalent to modern privacy panels.

triggers.line: I need other estimates before deciding.
The other fencing price was a lot lower.
We are not ready yet. Maybe later.

scenarios.title: Privacy at the side gate
scenarios.priority: Reduce visibility from the street and improve keyed access.
scenarios.constraint: Another estimate is $6,000 for open bars and a basic latch.
scenarios.opening: I want to see what fencing might cost, but I am shopping around.

scenarios.title: A more private side yard
scenarios.priority: Feel comfortable using the side yard.
scenarios.constraint: Other estimate is $9,000 for standard bars; timing depends on another home project.
scenarios.opening: We are looking at options. I am not promising anything today.

scenarios.title: The two-gate project
scenarios.priority: Secure both access points with a cohesive design.
scenarios.constraint: Competitor estimate is $7,500 with basic latches; wants scope in writing.
scenarios.opening: I need prices for the fence and both gates so I can compare.
